using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync_LogsErrorOnExceptionInCreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup the clusterProvider and other dependencies to cause CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync to throw
            migrateSession.SetupCreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsyncToThrow();

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // A derived class to override CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync to throw an exception to trigger the catch block
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;
            private bool _throwInCreateAndRun;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
            }

            public void SetupCreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsyncToThrow()
            {
                _throwInCreateAndRun = true;
            }

            public override ILogger logger => _logger;

            // Override the local function CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync by shadowing the method MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync
            public new async Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
            {
                var storeBeginAddress = 0L;
                var storeTailAddress = 100L;
                var mainStorePageSize = 4096;

                _logger?.LogWarning("Store migrate scan range [{storeBeginAddress}, {storeTailAddress}]", storeBeginAddress, storeTailAddress);

                async Task<bool> CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync(StoreType storeType, long beginAddress, long tailAddress, int pageSize)
                {
                    if (_throwInCreateAndRun)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated exception");
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                try
                {
                    var success = await CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync(StoreType.Main, storeBeginAddress, storeTailAddress, mainStorePageSize);
                    if (!success) return false;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger?.LogError(ex, "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}",
                        nameof(CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync), StoreType.Main, storeBeginAddress, storeTailAddress, mainStorePageSize);
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}
